public_rationale: The evidence supports the contextual reading that broad integration remained a substantial research problem in January 2023. WBAI identified unrealized abilities to combine and transfer knowledge, and DreamerV3 still trained separate agents for individual tasks. Gato shows that useful multimodal integration already existed, so the finding does not support a claim that all integration was unsolved. The conclusion concerns the general understanding Marcus describes, not a measured degree of difficulty.
limitations: The field-wide conclusion is an inference from a contemporary research assessment and system reports.
WBAI advocates a brain-inspired approach and its assessment is not a neutral census of all research.
The adjective 'huge' has no independently measurable threshold.

from_speaker: Integrating the parts in a whole
across essentially arbitrary domains and modalities
a reasonably cogent (if occasionally erroneous) understanding of the world
our_interpretation: The plain reading concerns integrating capabilities into broadly general intelligence, using the surrounding passage's description of cross-domain and cross-modal understanding.
It does not claim that nobody had combined AI components or built a multimodal system.
I read 'huge huge' as describing a substantial research challenge, without assigning a numerical measure of difficulty.
Because this describes an ongoing research state, I use January 2023 through the publication date as the latest reporting period. AI research has no standard quarterly reporting cycle.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous research and informed assessments identify substantial unresolved problems in combining knowledge and capabilities across domains into the general understanding described in the passage.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented system available during the target period demonstrates the broadly general integration described in the passage. Combining selected modalities or performing a collection of trained tasks alone is insufficient.

evidence.explanation: The January report describes strong results across diverse domains but leaves multi-task training and transfer for future investigation. This illustrates an unresolved integration problem; it does not establish that every other approach failed.
